title: vtc: answer after ring timeout, expire_ring tests
description:
vtc: answering after ring timeout, expire_ring coverage, small doc/test cleanups (batch 8b review, JMAP-8mem.7/.8, JMAP-0x0q.30).

1. crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/participant.rs (has("joinMethod") / has("callResponse") paths): no ring-deadline check, so after crate::call::expire_ring has sent a "timeout" VTCCallEndEvent to a still-pending target on an active ring call, that target can still answer and join. draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00 L1611: each other target "may still answer (and join) or decline until the ring timeout expires". Not in the MUST lists (L842-844, L860) and no callResponse value records it, so soft divergence: reject after the deadline, or record a decision.
2. crate-jmap-vtc-server/tests/participant.rs:1158-1210: expire_ring tests cover 29/30 s and active-ring cases only. Untested: Ok(false) for a non-ring call or a ring call not ringing/active (call.rs:741), notFound for an unknown id, invalidProperties naming createdAt for a malformed createdAt.
3. crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/query.rs:131-132: unbalanced backticks/quotes (`Servers "SHOULD require" `callId "on every query unless combined with `userId`".`) render garbled rustdoc. Spec text is vtc-00 L1076.
4. crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/event.rs mod tests (L414-415, 481-482, 495-496, 505-506, 514-515, 532-533, 547-548, 601-602, 617-618 and others): each json! literal has a duplicated, misindented `"accountId": "A1",` line left by a mechanical edit. Delete the misindented duplicate.
notes: Mark 2026-10-21: option B. Add VtcBackend::ring_timeout() defaulting to RING_TIMEOUT; handler rejects a still-pending target's late joinMethod answer / callResponse decline after createdAt+ring_timeout with invalidProperties [joinMethod]/[callResponse]; expire_ring drops its timeout parameter and uses the hook (BREAKING, CHANGELOG). Parts 2-4 landed in de243a16.
close_reason: Batch 10: committed and adversarially verified; CI green at d9d4d6af
